deals.summary: Fertitta closed his purchase of the Houston Rockets and Clutch City Sports and Entertainment after unanimous NBA Board of Governors approval, paying a record $2.2bn to Leslie Alexander. Stake not stated on the page (reported as the whole team).

owners.evidence: Ambassador Fertitta is the sole owner of Fertitta Entertainment, which owns the restaurant giant Landry’s, the Golden Nugget Hotel and Casinos, and the NBA’s Houston Rockets
owners.name: Tilman Fertitta (via Fertitta Entertainment)

ownership_summary: Owned by Tilman Fertitta through Fertitta Entertainment, of which he is sole owner; he closed the purchase of the Rockets and Clutch City Sports and Entertainment from Leslie Alexander in October 2017 for $2.2 billion. Fertitta has served as U.S. Ambassador to Italy. Front Office Sports (Oct 2025) lists the Rockets among teams with no private-equity connection.
